    About

    1995 in Denizli's textile industry since

    Denizli's textile know-how, for today's brands.

    We built our experience with Denizli's leading textile companies from 1995 and brought it together under the Berke Tekstil name in 2015.

    Today we manufacture for brands from design to shipment, and grow our own home textile brand, Fronte Home. That is why we know what makes a product sell.

    1. 1995The start

      Production experience with Denizli's leading textile companies.

    2. 2015Berke Tekstil

      Our experience under our own name; contract and private label manufacturing.

    3. TodayFronte Home

      Our own home textile brand, where we test fabrics and finishes on real customers.

    4. 2027Heimtextil, Frankfurt

      We will be at the fair with our samples on 12–15 January 2027. Write to us to meet.
